shellCommands.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/books -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"title":"The Hobbit","author":"J.R.R. Tolkien","notes":"A cozy reread."}' | head -c 400

BOOK_ID=$(curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -o '/books/[a-f0-9-]*' | head -1 | sed 's|/books/||')
echo "Book ID: $BOOK_ID"
echo "--- HOME PAGE (checking for title/author) ---"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -o 'The Hobbit\|J.R.R. Tolkien\|Currently Reading\|Finished' | sort -u
echo "--- DETAIL PAGE ---"
curl -s "http://localhost:3000/books/$BOOK_ID" | grep -o 'The Hobbit\|J.R.R. Tolkien\|A cozy reread\|Currently reading\|Mark as finished' | sort -u
echo "--- MARK FINISHED (follow redirect) ---"
curl -s -L -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{url_effective}\n" -X POST "http://localhost:3000/api/books/$BOOK_ID/finish"
echo "--- HOME PAGE AFTER FINISH ---"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -o 'The Hobbit\|Finished\|Done' | sort -u

echo "--- books.json persisted ---"
cat books.json
echo ""
echo "--- /add page loads ---"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/add
echo "--- nonexistent book returns 404 ---"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/books/does-not-exist
